name: Toggle3D.ai Inc.
summary: Toggle3D.ai Inc. delivers an innovative 3D CAD design studio software, driven by generative artificial intelligence. This Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solution leverages AI capabilities to efficiently transform CAD files, apply high-definition 4K textures, and facilitate the publishing of sophisticated 4K 3D models. Its services are tailored for a diverse clientele, including professional designers, digital artists, marketing specialists, and proprietors of e-commerce platforms. Based in Toronto, Canada, Toggle3D.ai Inc. functions as a subsidiary of Nextech3D.ai.
